numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Formatting with the "f" format type rounds incorrectly at the last digit: directed and nearest rounding truncate the last digit instead of rounding it up when a nonzero remainder lies past the extracted guard digits. Also, a value whose leading digit falls past the last requested place returns only zeros and ignores the rounding mode, e.g. format(mpf(0.0004), '.1Uf') gives 0.0.
numerical_failure.expected_behavior: The "f" format should agree with the "e" path and MPFR (gmpy2) rounding for the same value and rounding mode; e.g. format(mpf(0.0004), '.1Uf') should give 0.1 (rounded away from zero).

category_specific_evidence: Issue #1131: format(x, '.21Nf') and similar 'f' outputs disagree with gmpy2.mpfr, while the 'e' type with the same dps and rounding mode agrees.

Issue #1131 reproducer compares mpmath 'f' output with gmpy2 over random values, rounding modes N/U/D and dps in [15, 21, 30, 46, 100]; the comparison is exact string equality, so no tolerance is stated.
Commit message: format_fixed() extracts a handful of guard digits, so a nonzero remainder past them was invisible and directed and nearest rounding truncated the last digit.
The value is dyadic, so exactness at the extracted digits is decidable via exp + fractional_digits < 0 and is passed as an inexact/sticky flag into round_digits().
PR body: format(mpf(0.0004), '.1Uf') gave 0.0 where e/MPFR give 0.1, because an early return ignored the rounding mode.

Tie-case tests added: format(mp.mpf('0.125'), '.2Nf') == '0.12', format(mp.mpf('0.375'), '.2Nf') == '0.38', format(mp.mpf('2.5'), '.0Nf') == '2', format(mp.mpf('3.5'), '.0Nf') == '4', and carry case format(mp.mpf('0.6999999999'), '.4Uf') == '0.7000'.
Discussion: extracting digits until the dyadic expansion terminates needs about 0.3*|exp| digits, which is unbounded work for tiny exponents.
PR body: the defect reappears at higher precision because the zero run after the cutoff grows with prec - dps, so a fixed guard-digit increase only moves the boundary.
Issue #1131 and PR #1132 report a gmpy2 differential over doubles, precisions and all five rounding modes showing no mismatches after the fix, and regression tests were added in test_format.py.
